title: Airport trip then wants a person
persona: Frank Dunn, 70s, from Madison, slow speaker, distrusts automated systems.
goal: Start an airport trip, then insist on a real person.
opening_line: Yeah, I need a ride to the airport in Madison.

turns.caller: You know, I'd rather talk to a real person about this.

branches.if_agent: offers to continue the trip first
branches.caller: No, I don't like this. Get me somebody.

turns.caller: Can you put me through right now?

branches.if_agent: says the team will call back
branches.caller: When will they call? I don't want to wait all day.

turns.caller: 414-555-0144. Is that going to get to them?
And the trip I told you, do they know it?

curveballs: Pivot to a person after pickup
Pushes back if the agent tries to continue
hesitation_rules: Long pauses, says 'well now' before most answers.
expected: Honors the request for a person without arguing
Moves to the team path: callback or live connect attempt
Collects name and cell for callback
Says trip details already given go to the team or dispatch
must_not: Keep pushing trip questions after he insists
